summary: Poll legacy relay-close candidates without rebuilding unchanged mappings or per-message read jobs.

replay.detail: Existing candidate mappings and queued legacy-host cursors are reused without replay or backfill.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, wire operations or published schema shapes change.

rules.detail: Legacy compatibility polls read retained candidate pages directly. Their durable cursor advances only after terminal evidence and failed-answer retry jobs commit. Successful open answers create no per-message jobs; real selector and ownership changes still use changed-key discovery.

compatibility.detail: Peers without message-mark events retain the existing network polling schedule. Event-capable peers retain event subscriptions and discard any queued compatibility cursor without deleting failed-read retry jobs.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no conversion or extra startup scan.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: Cancellation replays an unacknowledged page. Failed network reads retain durable deadlines. Binary rollback can consume the same legacy-host cursor and retained candidate tables.
